## Purpose

<!-- hand:purpose -->
> Draft — owner review pending.

The whole-patient clinical scenario suite: one test file that runs the complete engine through anaesthesia scenarios —
induction in healthy, elderly, tamponade and hypovolaemic patients, sevoflurane, tension pneumothorax, massive PE,
anaphylaxis, malignant hyperthermia, VF with CPR, exsanguination and MANUAL mode — and checks the outcome against
published bands. It has no model code of its own. A clinician-educator can see which scenarios behave as expected and
which do not; an embedding developer can see the rig (`test/engine/clinical-suite.test.ts`).
<!-- /hand:purpose -->

## Equations in words

<!-- hand:equations -->
> Draft — owner review pending.

This page has no equations of its own: the suite checks the emergent behaviour of the other modules.

- Rig: adult, 40 y, 70 kg, male, seed 7, MODELED unless stated, intubated on volume control 12 × 600 mL, PEEP 5,
  FiO2 0.5 from t = 1 s (`test/engine/clinical-suite.test.ts`).
- Every physiological assertion reads the truth (SaO2, the circulation's state), never the displayed SpO2, so a monitor
  dropout cannot pass a test (`test/engine/clinical-suite.test.ts`).
- Each band names its source in the test title, e.g. Miller ch. 21 for propofol induction, Ebert 1995 for sevoflurane,
  Johnson 2003 for hypovolaemia, Ring & Messmer for anaphylaxis, Paradis 1990 for coronary perfusion pressure in CPR and
  MHAUS for MH (`test/engine/clinical-suite.test.ts`).
- A band the mechanism misses is an expected failure with the measured number in its title; these are listed under
  Known misses below and in `../validation/known-misses.md` (`test/engine/clinical-suite.test.ts`).
<!-- /hand:equations -->
